topic: Claude is eating your tokens: why a one-line question bills your whole conversation, and which habits silently break the cache
subject: where Claude Code's token bill actually goes, and which fixes move it
_reveal_note: NONE, deliberately. The reel NAMES every tool it recommends (ccusage, claude-hud, Ponytail, /clear) — nothing is withheld. The CTA delivers links/setup for the four, which is what 'I'll send all four' promises. Framework §6: do not promise one thing and deliver another. Recorded so no future session assumes a concealment campaign that was never designed, and so the weaker curiosity of a fully-revealed reel is a known trade, not an oversight.
